spec.title: [TEST] AI repair check on the Parkinson's rebuild, never posted
spec.statement: A local test of the Lab's AI repair step, never posted to the blockchain. The repository lists no package versions and uses a pandas feature that newer versions removed, so the AI has to work out the setup itself without changing the analysis. The published value is 0.696.

source.authors: Replication: M. Bourdenx, T. Paul. Original: M. Henderson et al.

artifact.entrypoint: python -c "import runpy, Robustness_Stability as R; R.random_robustness = lambda *a, **k: None; runpy.run_path('Pipeline.py', run_name='__main__')" > rerun_output.txt

metric.name: correlation between predicted and measured pathology at 3 months
